annotations.title: Compare the model with expert predictions

description: Experimental football outcome model trained on stored Sportmonks results. Returns a chronological holdout benchmark and comparisons with National expert groups on the same matches. Includes sample sizes, date windows, accuracy, Brier score and log loss. Paired rates stay unavailable below 50 published matches. Does not promise high confidence or future accuracy.
